answer: Make every seat cost a non-refundable burn priced near what one seat can expect to earn over its life, re-priced each epoch so the burn rises whenever emission does. An honest agent grading crystal assays for a mining client pays once and earns it back slowly through real work. A farm minting three hundred clones burns three hundred fees up front for zero surplus, and once auditors merge or slash the grove of linked accounts, its velvet-smooth plan becomes a pure loss.
